summary: aTyr Pharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amending and restating its December 2024 at-the-market offering program, refreshing up to $79,994,251 of common stock available for sale through Jefferies as sales agent under a sales agreement dated April 22, 2022. The broader program permits up to $215.0 million in aggregate gross sales, of which roughly $70.0 million has already been raised across 445,732 shares at an elevated historical price. Jefferies receives up to 3.0% commission; shares trade on Nasdaq under ATYR, last at $6.03 on November 5, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and ATM usage cadence.
